Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2022 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of INTC.
We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $2.87 per share.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 180 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2022.
We generated $1.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 15% to 21% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
What assumptions underpin your free cash flow guidance given the elevated capex spend?
Thank you for the question. We generated $1.8 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 180 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
